data.name: Somerville Happiness Survey
data.abstract: A data extract of a non-federal dataset posted here https://catalog.data.gov/dataset/somerville-happiness-survey-responses-2011-2013-2015

additional_info.summary: It is a case of supervised learning with the use of Receiver Operating Characteristic (ROC) to select the minimal set of attributes preserving or increasing predictability of the data.
additional_info.variable_info:
D = decision attribute (D) with values 0 (unhappy) and 1 (happy)
X1 = the availability of information about the city services
X2 = the cost of housing
X3 = the overall quality of public schools
X4 = your trust in the local police
X5 = the maintenance of streets and sidewalks 
X6 = the availability of social community events

Attributes X1 to X6 have values 1 to 5.
